title: Your first superposition
objective: Prepare the plus state from zero. Both amplitudes should be positive and equal.
hint: A Hadamard gate mixes zero and one with equal amplitudes.

title: Reveal relative phase
objective: Prepare one using an H-Z-H interference experiment.
hint: Place Z between two Hadamards. The final H turns relative phase into an outcome.

title: Which qubit is which?
objective: Prepare the basis state 01. q0 is the top wire and the rightmost bit.
hint: Apply X to q0 and leave q1 untouched.

title: Create a Bell pair
objective: Prepare (00 + 11) / sqrt(2). Matching counts alone is not enough: the phase must match too.
hint: Put H on q0, then CX with q0 as control and q1 as target.

title: Deutsch-Jozsa: balanced oracle
objective: Build the two-input XOR example. Prepare the helper q2 in minus, apply both oracle CX gates, then analyze q0 and q1 with H.
hint: Start X(q2), H on all three wires, CX(0,2), CX(1,2), then H on the two input wires. Read the lower two bits.

title: Grover search: amplify 11
objective: Amplify 11 with a phase oracle and one diffusion step.
hint: Prepare ++, apply CZ, then H-X-CZ-X-H with the single-qubit gates on both wires.

title: QAOA: one-edge max-cut
objective: Use a p=1 cost and mixer circuit to make the expected one-edge cut score at least 0.99.
hint: Prepare ++. Use RZZ(-pi/2), then RX(pi/4) on both qubits. RZZ can also be decomposed as CX-RZ-CX.

title: VQE: a one-qubit energy
objective: Find a trial state with energy below -1.11 for H = Z + 0.5X.
hint: Try RY(theta). The exact energy is cos(theta) + 0.5 sin(theta). Tune theta near 3.6 radians.
